title: Dreams of labyrinths?
content: I posted this to r/HighStrangeness and was directed here, which feels deeply relevant to what I've been experiencing and researching. I'm doing research into dreams, particularly around images or experiences of labyrinths or mazes within dreams. I'm a psychotherapist, but this work is independent of any institution. I can disclose that all throughout the past few months I have been dreaming of labyrinths, which is part of my motive for investigating this further. If you have recently dreamed of being within a labyrinth or have notable memories of past/historic dreams you've had, I would love to hear more. Particularly interested in those within the NYC area who may be experiencing this. Comment here or DM me directly, whatever suits you.
